Anita K: Quick pre-release checklist — we cut tomorrow at 18:00 UTC. Need final signoffs: QA, Security, Docs. PRs to merge: #4123 (version bump), #4134 (changelog), #4140 (flaky test fix). Ping owners below.
Benji: On #4123 — version bump script updated, ran locally `./scripts/bump-version 0.24.1` & smoke passed. Waiting CI.
Maria G: Docs PR #4134 ready, just needs final review for param docs. Quick review would be great.
Ryan: QA: running full regression now. Found one flakiness in streaming tests — PR #4140 fix looks good, will re-run.
Samir: Security review: scanned deps, no vuln hits; SecurityBot flagged transient policy on libXYZ but confirmed false-positive.
SecurityBot: Policy alert A-2026-87 acknowledged by Samir; manual override logged.
deploy-bot: Canary started on us-west-2 with 5% traffic. Monitor: https://canary.redwood.internal/1855001234
Benji: Also FYI, please avoid force-pushes to `release/v0.24` until we merge. If you must, @Benji should be pinged.
Maria G: Docs deployed to staging, search index updated.
Anita K: OK — can QA and Security + Docs give explicit :thumbsup: when green?
Ryan: QA :thumbsup: — regression clean after retest.
Samir: Security :thumbsup: — audit logged (ticket SEC-789).
Maria G: Docs :thumbsup: — small wording tweak done.
Anita K: Great. Last ask: someone run `git tag -a v0.24.1 -m "v0.24.1"` after CI green and I'll start the release window.
Benji: I can tag once CI passes.
Anita K: Cool. I'll post final cutoff reminder 30m before 18:00 UTC.
Ryan: Noted. If canary shows error rate > 1% rollback policy kicks in, right?
deploy-bot: Rollback policy is active; threshold=1.0%, window=5m. Automated rollback enabled.
Anita K: Thanks everyone. If any blockers, add them here. Otherwise we proceed to cut at scheduled time. :rocket:
